info.title: Global Resource Service
info.description:
The Global Resource Service (GRS) API provides actions for managing projects, orgs and other global resources including access rules on those resources.

GRS is a legacy Praxis Ruby app that lives in this repo:
https://github.com/rightscale/global_resource_service

For internal docs (Internal-use only; NOT public facing), see:
https://rs-docs-staging.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/platform/grs/docs/index.html

NOTE: GRS does not use swagger. Therefore GRS documentation is not viewable in service-map. Please use the above link to navigate to the GRS documentation.
